integration_notes.Petals of Steel: Restored the authenticated raw embedded module loader after automatic library localization interfered with its blob-only Content Security Policy. The policy is unchanged.
integration_notes.Rink Ruckus: Restored the original module loader and pointed its download base at local Three.js 0.186.1. The package.json from its pinned upstream commit confirms that exact version.
integration_notes.The Ashen Compact: Rebuilt the static game from the matching archive. The standalone export had collapsed $$ to $ during JavaScript String.replace substitution, causing a duplicate declaration. Source build produces a syntactically valid bundle with unchanged game logic.
integration_notes.Afterlight Arena Lab: Vendored the exact Babylon.js 9.28.0 package script plus license/notice; dynamic Three.js 0.186.1 loads use the existing local shelf.
integration_notes.Breakwater helicopter: Corrected the standalone nested entry favicon path from ../../favicon.svg to ../favicon.svg.
integration_notes.Client adapters: 12 React Site clients were built with a minimal React mount, their existing global CSS, Tailwind and pinned game dependencies. No Site auth/server/database routes were bundled; asset URLs are rooted under each game mount. Oddside uses React.lazy in place of the client-only next/dynamic entry wrapper.
integration_notes.Archives: Copied runtime assets and licenses only. Source ZIPs, database/save backups, report/review pages and tooling were omitted. Required game modes and connected in-game pages remain together.
integration_notes.Save identity: No localStorage/sessionStorage save identifiers were intentionally changed. New mounts preserve the supplied storage schemes; source-defined g-zero handling-record isolation remains intact.
integration_notes.Superkick Riot: Restored its package loader and redirected package fetches to the exact declared local dependencies: Three.js 0.186.1 and Rapier 0.20.0. This preserves the source-pinned physics version and avoids first-launch CDN requests.
integration_notes.Embedded engines: Standalone exports with embedded engine/module loaders retain their original bytes instead of an added import map. This preserves their exact Three.js/Rapier versions, including Flareline’s explicit Rapier 0.20.0 requirement.
integration_notes.Vesper Ninth Relay: Repaired one malformed data-setting CSS selector that incorrectly contained an aria-label attribute; the intended settings option query is unchanged.
